latest.content:
19 May 2026 07:00
RNS Number : 8063E
Westmount Energy Limited
19 May 2026
19th May 2026
WESTMOUNT ENERGY LIMITED
("Westmount" or the "Company")
Acquisition of JHI by Eco - JHI shareholder approval and Final Court Order Received
Westmount Energy Limited (
UK AIM:
WTE.L), the AIM-quoted oil and gas investing company focussed on high impact drilling outcomes in emerging basins,
is pleased to note the update provided by its investees
1,2
, further to the Company's announcement on the 5th May 2026 regarding the proposed acquisition of JHI Associates Inc. (
"JHI"
) by Eco (Atlantic) Oil and Gas Ltd. (
"Eco"
) by way of a court-approved plan of arrangement (the
"Arrangement"
). This update confirms that (1) at JHI's annual and special meeting of shareholders held on May 12, 2026, 100% of the votes cast were in favour of the plan of Arrangement with Eco and (2) JHI has successfully obtained on May 15, 2026 the final order approval (the
"Final Order"
) from the Ontario Superior Court of Justice (Commercial List) (the
"Court"
), approving the Arrangement as proposed.
These steps represent significant progress towards completion of the Arrangement. Remaining conditions for completion of the Arrangement
("Closing"
) include receipt of Falkland Islands Government (
"FIG"
) five-year licence extension of the PL001 licence and Navitas Petroleum LP's (via its subsidiary) operatorship; JHI to have a cash balance of US$1.0 million on completion of the Arrangement; and required TSX-V and AIM approvals. Eco expects the transaction to close as soon as the requisite government approvals are received, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions under the Arrangement agreement.
On completion of the Arrangement, Eco will hold 100% of the outstanding JHI shares and, in turn, a 35% participating interest in PL001, offshore Falkland Islands, operated by Navitas Petroleum LP (via its subsidiary - holding the remaining 65% interest) and a potential extension of JHI's 17.5% WI in the Canje Block offshore Guyana subject to ongoing government negotiations and approval. Completion of this Arrangement will boost the emergence of a new, Atlantic Margin, oil and gas exploration powerhouse with a diversified portfolio of assets offshore Guyana, Falkland Islands, Namibia and South Africa and partnerships with industry leading operators such as TotalEnergies, BP and Navitas Petroleum LP.
Subject to Closing and the completion of the additional transaction referenced in the Company's announcement of the 5th May 2026, Westmount will hold a total of 9,527,432 common shares in Eco which includes 4,000,000 Eco shares which are subject to lock-up provisions, plus Westmount's existing holding in Eco of 1,500,000 common shares.

latest.content:
Today 07:00
RNS Number : 0290D
Westmount Energy Limited
05 May 2026
5th May 2026
WESTMOUNT ENERGY LIMITED
("Westmount" or the "Company")
Acquisition of JHI by Eco and update on Westmount's shareholding
Westmount Energy Limited (
UK AIM:
WTE.L), the AIM-quoted oil and gas investing company focussed on high impact drilling outcomes in emerging basins,
is pleased to report that, further to the announcements on 11th March 2026 and 30th April 2026 of the proposed acquisition of JHI Associates Inc. ("
JHI
") by Eco (Atlantic) Oil and Gas Ltd. ("
Eco
")
1a,1b,2
, Westmount has now received from JHI the Shareholder Circular (the
"JHI Circular"
) published in connection with this transaction (the "
Acquisition
"). The Acquisition values JHI at approximately GBP£62.2M (approximately USD$88.5M) based upon the mid-market closing price of Eco's Common Shares on AIM of £0.65 on 1st May 2026. Pursuant to the Acquisition, Eco has agreed to acquire the issued and to be issued shares of JHI not already held by Eco based upon an exchange ratio of 0.7054 common Eco share for each JHI share. On completion of the Acquisition, Eco will issue up to 96,307,811 new Common Shares such that up to approximately 21.8% of Eco's enlarged issued share capital will be held by the shareholders of JHI. The completion of the Acquisition is subject to several closing conditions including the approval of two thirds of the votes cast by JHI Shareholders at an annual and special meeting to be held to approve the transaction on 12th May 2026. Eco has reported
1b
that shareholders representing approximately 60% of JHI's outstanding issued share capital have already entered into voting support agreements in favour of the Acquisition.
Westmount has been a longstanding shareholder in JHI, accumulating the majority of its stake via a placing and grey market cash share purchases and share swaps between December 2016 and January 2021. Westmount welcomes this Acquisition which, in the opinion of the Board of Directors of Westmount, represents a significant growth opportunity for JHI, offering synergies and potential cost savings across an enlarged portfolio, while also enhancing the liquidity of Westmount's shareholding in JHI. Westmount intends to vote in favour of the transaction at the JHI shareholders meeting scheduled for 12th May 2026.
JHI is a private, Ontario-registered, company established in 2014 and focused on oil exploration opportunities in the emerging Guyana-Suriname (17.5% W.I. Canje Block
3
) and North Falklands (35% W.I. PL001 Licence) basins. Eco is a publicly listed (AIM and TSX Venture Exchange) oil and gas exploration company with a diversified portfolio of assets offshore Guyana, Namibia and South Africa as well as a Strategic Partnership with Navitas Petroleum LP an international oil and gas exploration and production company.
Upon closing, this acquisition will result in JHI shareholders having exposure to a diversified portfolio of exploration and appraisal assets across the South Atlantic Margin, including assets in emerging, prolific, hydrocarbon provinces such as the Orange Basin, the Guyana Basin and the North Falklands Basin. In addition, JHI shareholders will have access to pre-funded, high impact, drilling opportunities in Block 3B/4B offshore South Africa, Orinduik Block, offshore Guyana and Licence PL001, offshore Falklands
4
. JHI shareholders will also benefit from Eco's strategic partnership with Navitas Petroleum LP ("
Navitas
"), previously announced on 4th December 2025
5
, which has the potential, via embedded option arrangements, to significantly enhance operational capacity and funding support for work programs with respect to other assets in the portfolio and additional new ventures. Furthermore, Eco's recently announced farm-down to BP
6
of a 60% Participating Interest and operatorship in three Walvis Basin Licences (PELs 97, 99 and 100), offshore Namibia, offers a significant new growth opportunity within the portfolio by providing funded work programs while retaining material exposure with potential for carried deepwater drilling on each of the three licences.
Shareholding Update
Prior to completion of the Acquisition, Westmount holds a total of 5,685,167 common shares and 50,000 warrants in JHI together with 1,500,000 common shares in Eco. In addition, Westmount has entered into a Memorandum of Agreement with a JHI management shareholder, conditional upon closing of the Acquisition, to purchase for a nominal amount an additional 4,000,000 common shares in Eco (equivalent to 5,670,542 JHI shares) immediately upon closing of the Acquisition. These additional 4,000,000 common shares in Eco are bound by the lock-up provisions contained in the lock-up agreement entered into by JHI management shareholders and Eco. Subject to completion of that purchase and the closing of the Acquisition, Westmount will hold a total of 9,527,432 common shares in Eco. This holding includes the conversion of currently held JHI shares and warrants using the exchange ratio and formula outlined in the JHI Circular, the newly purchased 4,000,000 Eco shares, plus Westmount's existing holding in Eco of 1,500,000 common shares.

company_30s.what_they_do: WTE is an investment holding company that owns a small percentage of a private exploration firm, Cataleya, which is involved in oil and gas drilling.
company_30s.why_they_matter: Even a modest stake can become valuable if the exploration company successfully finds commercial reserves, making WTE a potential beneficiary of future upside.
company_30s.current_state: The company is essentially a holding vehicle with no revenue of its own. It reports on its minority position and participates in routine corporate governance events. The share price is currently trading at a very low level relative to its valuation, but there is no clear operational trajectory.

rns_narrative: WTE has been busy updating the market on ownership changes, such as its 4.13 % stake in Cataleya, and on its involvement in a farm‑in of the North Falklands Basin licence. These moves signal that the company is keeping its portfolio active, but not generating earnings.

Financial reporting has been routine: interim results, AGM outcomes, and a recent statement on share‑price movement. These documents confirm that WTE is maintaining compliance but do not reveal new revenue streams.

The most recent corporate presentation reiterates the company’s investment focus and outlines the strategic intent behind its stake in Cataleya, hinting that the next big catalyst may come from the exploration firm’s drilling outcomes.

crowd_tape.dominant_theme: Quiet speculation around a small stake that could grow if the parent exploration company strikes oil.
crowd_tape.bull_narrative: Whackford’s posts highlight optimism that Cataleya’s drilling could turn the stake into a significant value driver.
crowd_tape.bear_narrative: Skeptics point out that a 4 % holding offers negligible upside and that the company has no revenue, making it a high‑risk play.
crowd_tape.sentiment_shift: The community remains largely silent; the few bullish remarks are balanced by neutral or cautious comments, indicating no clear trend.

whats_happening_now.attention_check: Google Trends is flat – there is no public buzz that could trigger a sudden price move.

near_term_catalysts: Cataleya’s first drilling report – a successful find could lift the value of WTE’s stake.
WTE’s upcoming AGM or a share‑price movement statement that might announce a change in stake or a new investment plan.
Any announcement of a partnership or acquisition involving Cataleya that would increase its market profile.
expect_next.watch_for: Look for a sudden volume spike and a breakout above the current 52‑week low. A press release from Cataleya or a formal change in WTE’s ownership percentage would be the most telling signs.
expect_next.timing_regime: The stock appears to be in the early stages of a potential recovery – it has not yet reached a clear low point and there is no evidence of a full capitulation. Confirmation will come only if a catalyst triggers a price rally.

buy_vs_sell.lean: Neutral – the lack of a deep crash and the absence of a clear catalyst make a decisive bullish stance premature.
buy_vs_sell.bull_case: If Cataleya announces a commercial oil discovery, WTE’s 4 % stake could appreciate substantially, turning a minor holding into a meaningful contributor to the share price.
buy_vs_sell.bear_case: The stake is too small to materially affect the company’s valuation, and WTE has no revenue or growth engine of its own. Without a breakthrough from Cataleya, the share may continue to drift at a low level.
buy_vs_sell.risk_reward: Potential upside is limited to the incremental value of the stake if Cataleya succeeds, while downside is essentially the current price level. The asymmetry is modest and would require a significant catalyst to justify a position.

playbook.if_bullish: Enter only after a confirmed positive drilling result from Cataleya or a clear increase in WTE’s stake. Position size should be a very small portion of the portfolio, and a stop should be placed just below the current 52‑week low to limit loss.
playbook.if_watching: Wait for a volume surge and a price break above the recent low. A news release from Cataleya or WTE announcing a change in ownership percentage would be the trigger.
playbook.if_passing: None identified – the company is not facing imminent delisting or bankruptcy.

ai_insights.bottom_line: WTE is a small holding with a modest stake in an exploration firm; until that firm delivers a commercial find, the stock offers limited upside and warrants a cautious, watch‑and‑wait approach.
